+    expected_valid: fixture?.expected_valid ?? false,
+    observed_valid: observedValid,
+    expected_promotion_allowed: fixture?.expected_promotion_allowed ?? false,
+    observed_promotion_allowed: observedPromotionAllowed,
+    status,

+  return {

+    validatorResult,

+  outRoot = repoRootFromScript(),

+  if (!isObject(artifacts)) {
+    throw new TypeError('artifacts must be an object');
+  }
+  writeJson(outRoot, paths.fixtureOut, artifacts.fixtureSet);
+  writeJson(outRoot, paths.validatorOut, artifacts.validatorResult);

+export function isDirectCliExecution(argv1 = process.argv[1]) {
+  if (!argv1) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  return pathToFileURL(path.resolve(argv1)).href === import.meta.url;
+}

+      HIGH_RISK_PREDICATES.has(fixture.semantic_assertion.predicate)
+    )
+  ));
+
+  const checks = [
+    check(
+      'adversarial_fixtures_not_accepted',
+      adversarialAccepted.length === 0 && highRiskAccepted.length === 0,
+      'Adversarial and high-risk fixtures are never accepted.',
+      {
+        adversarial_accepted_ids: adversarialAccepted.map((fixture) => fixture.fixture_id),
+        high_risk_accepted_ids: highRiskAccepted.map((fixture) => fixture.fixture_id),
+      },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'boundary_no_generation_or_remote_mutation',
+      fixtureSet.boundary.no_full_3530_generation &&
+        fixtureSet.boundary.no_external_model_calls &&
+        fixtureSet.boundary.no_runtime_integration &&
+        fixtureSet.boundary.no_remote_supabase_mutation &&
+        fixtureSet.boundary.no_production_rag_reindex,
+      'Boundary records fixture-only local work with no generation or remote mutation.',
+      { boundary: fixtureSet.boundary },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'coverage_required_families_present',
+      missingFamilies.length === 0 && missingPositiveNodeTypes.length === 0,
+      'Required positive and adversarial fixture families are present.',
+      { missing_families: missingFamilies, missing_positive_node_types: missingPositiveNodeTypes },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'deterministic_fixture_order',
+      JSON.stringify(fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.fixture_id)) ===
+        JSON.stringify([...fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.fixture_id)].sort(compareByteOrder)),
+      'Fixture IDs are sorted in deterministic byte order.',
+    ),
+    check(
+      'fixture_provenance_and_scope_valid',
+      failedFixtureResults.length === 0,
+      'Every fixture has status, scope, provenance, confidence, and expected outcome metadata.',
+      { failed_fixture_ids: failedFixtureResults.map((item) => item.fixture_id) },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'input_artifacts_loaded',
+      inputDiagnostics.length === 0,
+      'Required upstream SEM-KG contract artifacts loaded.',
+      { input_diagnostics: inputDiagnostics },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'positive_statuses_cover_required_layers',
+      ['raw_candidate', 'triangulated_candidate', 'provisional_safe', 'accepted'].every((status) => (
+        positiveStatuses.has(status)
+      )) && STATUS_ORDER.every((status) => statusSet.has(status)),
+      'Positive fixtures cover candidate/provisional/accepted layers and the full set covers all status values.',
+      {
+        positive_statuses: [...positiveStatuses].sort(compareByteOrder),
+        observed_statuses: [...statusSet].sort(compareByteOrder),
+      },
+    ),
+    check(
+      'reviewable_fixture_size',
+      fixtureSet.fixtures.length <= fixtureSet.reviewability.fixture_count_limit &&
+        fixtureSet.reviewability.full_3530_generation_performed === false,
+      'Fixture set is bounded and reviewable.',
+      { reviewability: fixtureSet.reviewability },
+    ),
+  ].sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.id, right.id));
+
+  const validationStatus = checks.every((item) => item.status === 'pass') ? 'pass' : 'fail';
+  return {
+    schema_version: 'semantic_kg_gold_adversarial_fixtures_validator_result.v0',
+    generated_at: fixtureSet.generated_at,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: 1319,
+    parent_issue: 1313,
+    fixture_path: DEFAULT_PATHS.fixtureOut,
+    input_diagnostics: inputDiagnostics,
+    summary: {
+      validation_status: validationStatus,
+      check_count: checks.length,
+      check_pass_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status === 'pass').length,
+      check_fail_count: checks.filter((item) => item.status === 'fail').length,
+      fixture_count: fixtures.length,
+      positive_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((item) => item.fixture_kind === 'gold').length,
+      adversarial_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((item) => item.fixture_kind === 'adversarial').length,
+      fixture_pass_count: fixtureResults.filter((item) => item.status === 'pass').length,
+      accepted_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((item) => item.semantic_assertion.status === 'accepted').length,
+      blocked_quarantined_fixture_count:
+        fixtures.filter((item) => item.semantic_assertion.status === 'blocked_quarantined').length,
+      external_model_call_count: 0,
+      remote_supabase_mutation_performed: false,
+      production_rag_reindex_performed: false,
+    },
+    checks,
+    fixture_results: fixtureResults,
+  };
+}
+
+function buildReadback({ fixtureSet, validatorResult }) {
+  const statusRows = Object.entries(fixtureSet.coverage.status_counts)
+    .sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left[0], right[0]))
+    .map(([status, count]) => `| ${status} | ${count} |`);
+  const familyRows = fixtureSet.coverage.families
+    .map((family) => `| ${family.family_id} | ${family.fixture_ids.join(', ')} |`);
+  const checkRows = validatorResult.checks
+    .map((item) => `| ${item.id} | ${item.status} |`);
+  const fixtureRows = fixtureSet.fixtures
+    .map((fixture) => (
+      `| ${fixture.fixture_id} | ${fixture.fixture_kind} | ${fixture.family_id} | ` +
+      `${fixture.semantic_assertion.status} | ${fixture.expected_promotion_allowed} |`
+    ));
+
+  return [
+    '# Semantic KG Gold And Adversarial Fixtures Readback',
+    '',
+    `Generated at: \`${fixtureSet.generated_at}\``,
+    `Issue: #${fixtureSet.issue}`,
+    `Parent: #${fixtureSet.parent_issue}`,
+    '',
+    '## Boundary',
+    '',
+    '- Fixture-only local artifact set; no full 3530 generation was performed.',
+    '- No external model/API calls, runtime integration, frontend work, Supabase mutation, or RAG reindex were performed.',
+    '- Adversarial and high-risk fixtures are machine-checkable and are not accepted runtime truth.',
+    '',
+    '## Counts',
+    '',
+    `- Fixtures: ${fixtureSet.summary.fixture_count}`,
+    `- Gold fixtures: ${fixtureSet.summary.positive_fixture_count}`,
+    `- Adversarial fixtures: ${fixtureSet.summary.adversarial_fixture_count}`,
+    `- Accepted fixtures: ${fixtureSet.summary.accepted_fixture_count}`,
+    `- Blocked/quarantined fixtures: ${fixtureSet.summary.blocked_quarantined_fixture_count}`,
+    `- Validator status: \`${validatorResult.summary.validation_status}\``,
+    '',
+    '## Status Counts',
+    '',
+    '| Status | Count |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...statusRows,
+    '',
+    '## Fixture Families',
+    '',
+    '| Family | Fixture IDs |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...familyRows,
+    '',
+    '## Fixtures',
+    '',
+    '| Fixture | Kind | Family | Expected status | Promotion allowed |',
+    '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |',
+    ...fixtureRows,
+    '',
+    '## Validator',
+    '',
+    '| Check | Status |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...checkRows,
+    '',
+  ].join('\n');
+}
+
+export function buildSemanticKgGoldAdversarialFixtures(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options);
+  const generatedAt = options.generatedAt ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT;
+  const paths = {
+    ...DEFAULT_PATHS,
+    ...(options.paths ?? {}),
+  };
+  const inputDiagnostics = [];
+  const inputs = {
+    sourceManifest: readJsonInput(root, paths.sourceManifest, 'semantic_kg_source_manifest', inputDiagnostics),
+    segmentationModel:
+      readJsonInput(root, paths.segmentationModel, 'semantic_kg_segmentation_model', inputDiagnostics),
+    statusModel: readJsonInput(root, paths.statusModel, 'semantic_kg_status_model', inputDiagnostics),
+    taxonomyContract:
+      readJsonInput(root, paths.taxonomyContract, 'semantic_kg_taxonomy_contract', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialAlignment:
+      readJsonInput(root, paths.officialAlignment, 'semantic_kg_official_alignment_layer', inputDiagnostics),
+    officialAlignmentFixtures:
+      readJsonInput(
+        root,
+        paths.officialAlignmentFixtures,
+        'semantic_kg_official_alignment_fixtures',
+        inputDiagnostics,
+      ),
+    fullBetaRuntimeSourceMap:
+      readJsonInput(root, paths.fullBetaRuntimeSourceMap, 'full_beta_runtime_source_map', inputDiagnostics),
+  };
+  const sourceArtifactInventory = buildSourceArtifactInventory(paths, root, inputs);
+  const sourceContract = buildSourceContract(paths, inputs, sourceArtifactInventory);
+  const objectiveNodes = inputs.officialAlignment?.seed_nodes?.syllabus_objectives ?? [];
+  const fixtures = buildFixtures({
+    generatedAt,
+    paths,
+    objectiveNodes,
+  });
+  const coverage = buildCoverage(fixtures);
+  const fixtureSet = {
+    schema_version: 'semantic_kg_gold_adversarial_fixtures.v0',
+    generated_at: generatedAt,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    issue: 1319,
+    parent_issue: 1313,
+    depends_on_issues: [1314, 1315, 1333, 1317, 1316, 1334],
+    subject_code: SUBJECT_CODE,
+    objective:
+      'Build a bounded gold/adversarial fixture gate for semantic KG candidate generation and promotion.',
+    boundary: buildBoundary(),
+    source_contract: sourceContract,
+    source_artifact_inventory: sourceArtifactInventory,
+    reviewability: {
+      fixture_count_limit: 20,
+      full_3530_generation_performed: false,
+      within_fixture_count_limit: fixtures.length <= 20,
+      selection_policy:
+        'Small representative v0 set across papers/topics/difficulty patterns; not a production generation sample.',
+    },
+    coverage,
+    fixtures,
+    summary: {
+      fixture_count: fixtures.length,
+      positive_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((item) => item.fixture_kind === 'gold').length,
+      adversarial_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((item) => item.fixture_kind === 'adversarial').length,
+      accepted_fixture_count: fixtures.filter((item) => item.semantic_assertion.status === 'accepted').length,
+      blocked_quarantined_fixture_count:
+        fixtures.filter((item) => item.semantic_assertion.status === 'blocked_quarantined').length,
+      status_counts: coverage.status_counts,
+      risk_tier_counts: coverage.risk_tier_counts,
+      external_model_call_count: 0,
+      remote_supabase_mutation_performed: false,
+      production_rag_reindex_performed: false,
+    },
+  };
+  const fixtureResults = fixtures.map(evaluateFixture)
+    .sort((left, right) => compareByteOrder(left.fixture_id, right.fixture_id));
+  const validatorResult = validateFixtureSet({
+    fixtureSet,
+    fixtureResults,
+    inputDiagnostics,
+  });
+  const readback = buildReadback({
+    fixtureSet,
+    validatorResult,
+  });
+
+  return {
+    fixtureSet,
+    validatorResult,
+    readback,
+    paths,
+  };
+}
+
+export function writeSemanticKgGoldAdversarialFixtureArtifacts({
+  outRoot = repoRootFromScript(),
+  artifacts,
+  paths = DEFAULT_PATHS,
+} = {}) {
+  if (!isObject(artifacts)) {
+    throw new TypeError('artifacts must be an object');
+  }
+  writeJson(outRoot, paths.fixtureOut, artifacts.fixtureSet);
+  writeJson(outRoot, paths.validatorOut, artifacts.validatorResult);
+  writeText(outRoot, paths.readbackOut, artifacts.readback);
+}
+
+export function isDirectCliExecution(argv1 = process.argv[1]) {
+  if (!argv1) {
+    return false;
+  }
+  return pathToFileURL(path.resolve(argv1)).href === import.meta.url;
+}
